project.name: autonomous-market-os
project.description: Autonomous Market OS is a paper-only quantitative market-research and portfolio-inspection workspace. Market OS owns quantitative math, probability, stability, calibration, risk, and paper decisions; Jev's intended role is advisory evidence assessment, but authentic local Jev remains unverified. Public market-data capture and synthetic hosted-Jev connectivity require bounded explicit opt-in. BTC evidence packets stay local; live trading and public mutation routes are disabled. The graph maps 709 repository files.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to see how the repository is run and which application surfaces it currently ships. It frames the system as a local, synthetic and paper-only market research workspace, so that scope guides the rest of the tour.

tour.title: Architecture and Scope
tour.description: The structure map explains how the repository divides the domain package, gateway, web operator, desktop shell, deployment files and supporting evidence. The technical design then connects those surfaces to BTC data, quantitative research, Jev assessment, calibration and paper-risk controls.

tour.title: CLI and Contracts
tour.description: The Python module entry point hands command-line execution to the shared Market OS dispatcher. That dispatcher exposes inspection and research workflows over versioned contracts, whose validators make requests, evidence, results and risk decisions explicit before later layers act.

tour.title: Market Data Timing
tour.description: Historical ingestion checks approved BTC archive inputs, closed candles, checksums and bounded local storage, while the realtime capture path records one-minute observations for later local inspection and replay. Clock diagnostics are kept read-only; timestamp quality remains an eligibility condition for future research rather than an assumption made by the ingest path.

tour.title: Quantitative BTC Baselines
tour.description: B2 turns hash-checked candle history into deterministic features and labels, then evaluates numerical baselines with chronological splits and calibration separated from test predictions. The report records the resulting persistence, replay and holdout analyses, making this the quantitative path that remains distinct from evidence assessment.

tour.title: Local Evidence Retrieval
tour.description: MiniRAG retrieves from caller-owned local documents using deterministic local embedding and extraction functions, with no hosted-model configuration passed to its child runtime. The research synthesizer keeps exact quotes and source references, and the brief renderer carries those citations and hash-bound lineage into a readable evidence artifact.

tour.title: Jev Assessment Semantics
tour.description: The Jev processing guide defines evidence support, contradiction, provenance, timestamps and abstention separately from a market-outcome forecast. B3.1 question contracts enforce those rules, while the offline Jev-shaped benchmark measures incremental value from recorded responses and fails closed on timing or response problems.

tour.title: Runtime Identity Boundaries
tour.description: The connectivity module contains the hosted Jev API adapter, while the separate local assessor runs a pinned Qwen model for evidence support, contradiction and abstention. The accepted runtime decision explicitly says Qwen is not Jev and leaves market prediction, calibration, risk and paper execution with Market OS; keep these identities distinct when interpreting local results.

tour.title: Paper Decision Flow
tour.description: After numerical signals are normalized, the strategy applies deterministic buy, sell, hold or abstain behavior and rejects inputs that fail status, timing or fingerprint checks. The synthetic venue models fills, fees, spread and slippage, while the portfolio broker persists paper-only ledger state from approved policy and recorded market events.

tour.title: Persisted Research Evidence
tour.description: The local store writes restart-safe events, immutable content-addressed artifacts and recovery metadata so runs can be reconstructed without rewriting prior artifacts. BTC inspection reads persisted B2 and B3 manifests and results, checks their lineage and integrity, and exposes bounded pages without starting new research or ingestion.

tour.title: Local API Gateway
tour.description: The gateway entry point starts the existing Market OS application API, which provides bounded inspection routes and validates paths, query limits and local storage access. The web adapter calls that Python surface on loopback and converts its responses into typed access to BTC candles, manifests, realtime captures and research runs.

tour.title: Research Desk
tour.description: The desk combines local realtime BTC data, historical fallback, recent B2/B3 runs and portfolio inspection while preserving independent error states for each resource. Its chart refreshes the latest local capture every three minutes and can display historical or synthetic fixture views, giving the operator a read-oriented window over the pipeline built in earlier steps.

tour.title: Operations and Delivery
tour.description: Compose describes the loopback-oriented gateway and operator topology, with optional observability and MLflow services connected through explicit health and storage dependencies. The CI workflow checks offline and integration paths, release evidence, containers and the read-only dashboard packaging so local capabilities remain tied to repeatable delivery evidence.
tour.languageLesson: Compose health checks and service dependencies make readiness order explicit, while named volumes keep selected local state separate from container lifecycles.

tour.title: Evaluation and Gates
tour.description: The B3.1 protocol defines leakage-safe folds, calibration and fusion, stability, abstention metrics and promotion gates using recorded fixtures rather than authorizing a provider call. Focused tests exercise quantitative feature timing and calibration, evidence-response precedence, local Qwen identity, egress preflight and deterministic replay; read them against the protocol before treating a local smoke as model or market validation.
